From what Latin adjective with what meaning do we derive the word “ineptitude”? ANSWER: APTUS – SUITABLE/ FITTING BONUS: What English word from the same Latin root means “expert, or skilled”? ANSWER:ADEPT BONUS: What English word from the same Latin root means “a rope”? ANSWER:LARIAT
